summary: What a data component shows when it is working and has found nothing — a title, a reason, and the thing to do about it.

figma.note: Not drawn in Figma. Built in code first, from docs/content/empty-and-loading-states.md. `Error page` in the file is the nearest component and a different job — 404 and 500 are the app having failed.

pairs.do: Name what is missing and what would bring it back — "No alerts in the last 24 hours. Widen the time range to see older activity."
pairs.why: The whole component exists for this. A title with no reason leaves the reader unable to tell a working empty list from a broken one, which is why `description` is a required prop rather than an optional one.

pairs.dont: Use one state for both, so a product nobody has set up yet says "No endpoints match your filters".
pairs.do: Empty asks for a change to the question; first use asks for setup and says what will appear once it is done.
pairs.why: They need different actions. Offering "Clear filters" to someone who has never connected a source sends them looking for a filter that is not there — and implies they broke something.

pairs.dont: Replace the chart with an empty state because one of four sources failed.
pairs.do: Draw what loaded and put an Alert above it naming what did not.
pairs.why: Partial means there IS something to show. A centred block in place of the data hides the part that worked, which is the "never silently drop a source" rule inverted — now the working sources are the ones dropped.

pairs.dont: Show an empty state while the request is still in flight.
pairs.do: Show a Skeleton, and the empty state only once the answer is known to be nothing.
pairs.why: An empty state during a load is a wrong answer shown confidently. The guidance prefers a skeleton to a spinner because the layout is already known.

pairs.dont: Put the 160 drawing inside a chart frame or a popover.
pairs.do: Use `size="sm"` there — an icon, tighter padding, no drawing. `md` is for a page, a table body or a panel.
pairs.why: A drawing larger than the space it is explaining reads as a page that failed rather than a widget with nothing in it. `illustration` is ignored at `sm` so this cannot be got wrong by accident.

a11y: A plain block of text in reading order — no role, so it does not announce itself on mount.
It is NOT a live region. A component that swaps a Skeleton for an empty state should announce that itself, where it knows the request finished; a role="status" here would also fire on first paint.
The illustration is drawn with `label={null}` and `interactive={false}`: the title beside it says the same thing, and nothing in an empty state should answer the pointer.
`icon` is aria-hidden. Everything it suggests is in the title and description.
